message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a white background and a red vertical bar on the left. Centered is a stylized portrait of a man with dark hair, wearing a gray short-sleeved police-style uniform with red and gold shoulder boards. His right arm is bent, hand pointing towards his chest. Superimposed on his chest and stomach is a semi-transparent, smaller portrait of a different man with graying hair and a mustache, wearing a white collared shirt. Both men have neutral, direct expressions.

The main figure stands against a gray silhouette-like shadow. On his left sleeve is a colorful circular patch. Legible text includes the masthead "TEMPO" in large white letters. Above it is "KRIMINALISASI PENENTANG REKLAMASI". To the left is a bold black headline: "MENGAPA WASESO MERADANG". Smaller text below reads "MEMERIKSA BISNIS TOMY WINATA, ANAK BUAH BEKAS KEPALA BADAN RESERSE KRIMINAL KEPOLISIAN RI DITUDING MELANGGAR PROSEDUR. BUAH PERSETERUAN PETINGGI POLRI?" At the bottom left are date and price details "29 AGUSTUS–4 SEPTEMBER 2016 RP 39.500" and a barcode.
